async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Search for 'awesome-python' using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name")
    await searchbox.fill("awesome-python")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filtering
    
    # Step 2: Find the project heading containing 'awesome-python'
    # Use filter to match the text in the heading
    project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading", level=2).filter(has_text="awesome-python")
    await project_heading.wait_for(state="visible")
    
    # Step 3: Get the exact project name from the heading text
    project_name = await project_heading.text_content()
    
    # Step 4: Use knowledge base function to navigate to project details
    await navigate_to_project_details(page, project_name)
    
    # Step 5: On project details page, find and click the 'Issues' link
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Issues")
    await issues_link.click()
    
    # Step 6: Click 'New issue' to start creating an issue
    new_issue_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="New issue")
    await new_issue_link.click()
    
    # Step 7: Fill in the issue title and description using get_by_role
    # Assuming the title input has role 'textbox' with name 'Title'
    title_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title")
    await title_input.fill("Request for Python 3.11 related resources")
    
    # Assuming the description textarea has role 'textbox' with name 'Description'

    await description_input.fill("Hello, I would like to ask about your plans for adding Python 3.11 related resources to this project. Are there any updates or timelines for this?")
    
    # Step 8: Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Submit issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    
    # Wait for the issue to be created
